title: IZABRIGHT-Lung02: Study of Izalontamab Brengitecan (BMS-986507) in Combination with Osimertinib versus Osimertinib Monotherapy or Osimertinib in Combination with Platinum-based Chemotherapy for First-Line Locally Advanced or Metastatic EGFR-Mutant Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
official: A Phase III, Randomized, Open label Study of Izalontamab Brengitecan (Iza-bren/BMS-986507/BL-B01D1) in Combination with Osimertinib versus Osimertinib Monotherapy or Osimertinib in combination with Platinum-based Chemotherapy as First-Line Therapy in Patients with EGFR-Mutant Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
summary: Main objective: The main goal of this study is to find out whether patients who receive iza-bren together with osimertinib can live longer without their cancer getting worse, compared with those receiving the current standard treatment.
conditions: Cáncer de pulmón no microcítico localmente avanzado o metastásico con mutación activadora del EGFR
EGFR-Mutant Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. This study is open to adults aged 18 and older with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC harbouring a confirmed EGFR exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R substitution.
2. Patients must have at least one measurable tumour outside the brain, be fully active or have only minor restrictions on physically strenuous activity (ECOG Performance Status 0 or 1), and have a tumour tissue sample available prior to treatment.
3. Prior adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy is permitted if the last dose was given at least 4 weeks before randomization, and prior adjuvant immunotherapy if at least 8 weeks have elapsed; however, patients whose cancer progressed within 12 months of completing platinum-based chemotherapy will not receive that chemotherapy as part of this study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients are not eligible if they have active, symptomatic, or uncontrolled brain metastases, although those with stable, asymptomatic brain metastases may still qualify.
2. Patients will also be excluded if they have a concurrent malignancy or a history of prior malignancy that was active within the two years prior to treatment assignment.
3. Further exclusion criteria include any serious or uncontrolled medical disorder, an active infection, or clinically significant findings on physical examination or laboratory testing.
4. Additionally, patients with an altered mental status or psychiatric conditions that may affect their ability to participate will not be eligible.
5. Finally, any patient who has previously received systemic antitumor therapy as a first-line treatment for advanced disease will also be excluded.
